dogecoin.text: @joshisatree @dogecoin True, 😂 I would have never imagined that a doge currency would exist 🤣

@joshisatree @dogecoin I get that, but crypto currency is not really available for everybody. As I see it it's something for people in "rich" countries to play around with, for 2 reasons: first it's not recognized as an actual currency worldwide and it's not accessible an investment 4 all.
@joshisatree @dogecoin I still can't fathom the excitement over crypto currency. It is just a type of currency, it's like getting excited over Euros or Dollars 😅
